verdict.rationale: VirtualPostMail's developer page says users can 'use our API directly to take full control of your workflow' and connect via Zapier. That implies headless, programmatic operation without the web UI, and the product also offers server-side automation rules. Beyond this one-line marketing mention there is no API reference, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec, llms.txt or markdown docs. missing for 10: documented API reference/auth model (e.g. API keys usable non-interactively despite 2FA), CLI or SDK, CI/headless usage guidance, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
